caption_L1: This bar plot is titled Artillery and heavy guns used by the British forces during the First Battle of the Somme in 1916. The y-axis plots Weapon type using a categorical scale with BL 12-inch Howitzer on one end and QF 4.7-inch naval gun Mk I at the other. Along the x-axis, Number of guns is defined on a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 800.
caption_L2L3: The British forces had more of the QF 18 pounder gun than any other gun that is on the graph. This is followed by the QF 4.5 inch howitzer, however, there is at least 600 more 18 pounder guns than there is the 4.5 inch howitzer.
